entity: California health professional shortage areas proposed for withdrawal in 2026
what_we_add: the 2.7-3.5M people affected, the 74-90 net-of-redesignation count, and the 3x national rate
why: Hospital Council and CHA report ~100 of California's HPSAs proposed for withdrawal, same entity, same direction, within 25% of our gross figure. No source has population counts or the national comparison. The July delay to 2027 does not reverse the direction.
